main_issue: Whether and when Agent D can cook strong-smelling food (sambal belacan) in the shared kitchen, given the smell affecting the living room, B's room and the laundry

A-B.evidence: B backs A's complaint (T2) and suggests closing doors (T8); both end up accepting D's Tue/Thu after 7 p.m. plus window-and-door arrangement (T25-26).

A-C.evidence: C proposes cooking on non-laundry nights (T11); A says it doesn't solve the living room (T12), but later the Tue/Thu after-7 plan is accepted by both (T20-21).

A-D.evidence: D resists the ban (T4, T6, T15); A offers after 7 p.m. or Saturday (T16) and D agrees (T17, T20).

B-C.evidence: B concedes door-closing doesn't solve laundry (T10); B notes time doesn't fix the laundry (T18); C backs the Mon/Wed/Fri rule (T19); both accept the final plan.

B-D.evidence: B says the smell still gets in (T18, T23); D offers to open the window and B accepts if the door is closed (T25-26).

C-D.evidence: D initially deflects (T4); C proposes other nights (T11); D accepts Tue/Thu (T20) and C confirms (T21).
